policy.futureWord: Rewrite to an already-learned word when natural.
policy.indispensableUnknown: Keep only when necessary and attach English/Japanese gloss from the v7 master or another explicit verified source.
policy.morphology: A known base form is not enough; the inflected form must also pass the grammar chronology gate.
policy.properNoun: Do not auto-approve merely because capitalization suggests a proper noun.
policy.priorReviewedCumulative: Earlier explicit reviewed vocabulary in the same textbook and grade may satisfy cumulative vocabulary chronology; later sections must never satisfy an earlier passage.
policy.scanner: The final vocabulary gate must be derived from canonical v7 chronology, not from per-passage allowedWords alone.
